documentary_director.name: Documentary Director
documentary_director.description: A veteran documentary filmmaker valuing depth, slow pacing, and reflection.

cinematic_editor.name: Cinematic Editor
cinematic_editor.description: A feature film editor focused on visual tension release, continuity, and memory.

general_viewer.name: General YouTube Viewer
general_viewer.description: An average viewer looking for a clear story that is neither too fast nor too slow.

shorts_addict.name: Shorts Addict
shorts_addict.description: An ultra-fast consumer with zero tolerance for scenery, silence, or slow setups.

travel_vlogger.name: Travel Vlog Fan
travel_vlogger.description: Enjoys travel and lifestyle vlogs, preferring high tempo and quick visual scenery changes.

emotional_purist.name: Emotional Video Lover
emotional_purist.description: Highly sensitive to character expressions, background melodies, and narrative emotion.

slow_breather.name: Slow Breathing Enthusiast
slow_breather.description: Values silent pauses, quiet scenes, ambient sounds, and cinematic pacing.

fast_tempo.name: Fast Pacing Enthusiast
fast_tempo.description: Demands active cuts, constant motion, and snappy dialogue exchanges.

info_centric.name: Information-Centric Viewer
info_centric.description: Focuses on text accuracy, spoken facts, narration layout, and clear information flow.

emotion_centric.name: Emotion-Centric Viewer
emotion_centric.description: Focuses on faces, character dialogue, reaction timing, and empathetic narrative flow.
